summaries.en: Foreign media reports indicate that President Trump has lost patience with the prolonged Iran conflict and stalled peace talks, now favoring military action and entering a 'revenge mode' against Iran.
summaries.zh: 据外媒报道，特朗普总统对旷日持久的伊朗冲突和停滞不前的和平谈判失去耐心，倾向于采取军事行动，并对伊朗进入“报复模式”。
